name: Boise River (Greenbelt)
gaugeName: Boise River at Glenwood Bridge nr Boise
blurb: Idaho's busiest tube run — Barber Park to downtown, with a city shuttle and 100,000+ floaters a summer.

sections.notes: Six-mile city float with three Class II rapids. Use the designated Ann Morrison river-left takeout and arrange the seasonal shuttle before launching.

guideTimes.conditions: Ada County summer float guidance for Barber Park to Ann Morrison. Actual time varies with flow, craft and stops; not a calibrated live-flow model.
guideTimes.sourceName: Ada County Parks & Waterways Float the Boise guide (2025)

notices.title: Exit at Ann Morrison
notices.text: The city river map identifies a low-head dam downstream of the designated floater takeout. Do not treat the downstream city river as a continuation of the managed summer float.

takeOut.name: Ann Morrison Park
takeOut.sourceLocation: Route map and typical Boise River float FAQ

distanceEvidence.note: The county publishes this as an approximate six-mile float, taking two to three hours in its seasonal float guide. Guide time is separate from a live estimate.

putInAccess.sourceName: City of Boise Fire Department Float the Boise public access map
putInAccess.note: The official public-access map identifies this designated landing; satellite review places it at the beach/stair access, not in a parking lot. Launch only during the official float season after the river is opened.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: City of Boise Fire Department Float the Boise public access map
takeOutAccess.note: The official public-access map identifies this designated landing; satellite review places it at the beach/stair access, not in a parking lot. All floaters must exit at Ann Morrison Park; the diversion dam downstream is dangerous.
takeOutAccess.bankSourceName: Ada County Parks & Waterways — Float the Boise guide (2025)
takeOutAccess.bankNote: The agency guide explicitly places the Ann Morrison takeout on river left, facing downstream. This agrees with the reviewed official takeout feature and satellite placement.

sections.notes: A downstream extension beyond the managed summer float has not been reviewed.
sections.accessReview: The former Class I Ann Morrison–Eagle listing crosses diversion-dam and whitewater-park hazards. Boise identifies a low-head dam below the designated floater takeout; a suitable through-route and exact Eagle exit have not been established. This listing is withheld from trip planning.
